# Live Demos

Small apps vibe-coded with Claude Code. Each folder has the **full
prompt-by-prompt build log**, the **exact source** running on the live site,
what to notice in the build, and a **remix prompt** to rebuild it yourself.

| Demo | What it shows | Try it |
|------|---------------|--------|
| [Tip Splitter](./tip-splitter/README.md) | The classic first vibe-coding project — bill, tip, split, with honest cent-rounding. Built in four prompts. | [live ▶](https://vibecodeschool.com/demos/tip-splitter) |
| [Focus Timer](./focus-timer/README.md) | A 25/5 pomodoro timer with phase auto-switching and a progress bar — and a React interval bug the agent had to fix properly. | [live ▶](https://vibecodeschool.com/demos/focus-timer) |
| [CLAUDE.md Generator](./claude-md-generator/README.md) | Answer six questions, get a ready-to-commit CLAUDE.md for your repo. The most-requested artifact from Course 01, as a tool. | [live ▶](https://vibecodeschool.com/demos/claude-md-generator) |

The point of publishing build logs: finished apps teach you nothing about the
process. The learning lives in the turns — what was asked, what broke, and how
the correction was phrased.
